name: ideation-hub-platform
description: Canonical Ideation Hub schema, REST API, and MCP tools, plus the MCP server. The developer and requirements plugins require this plugin. Cursor has no plugin-dependency field, so that requirement is documented in each of those plugins.

variables.name: IH_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Ideation Hub Agent Client ID (minted at https://www.ideationhub.me/settings/agents?setup=grokbot)

variables.name: IH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Ideation Hub Agent Client Secret (shown once when creating the Agent Credential at https://www.ideationhub.me/settings/agents?setup=grokbot)

setupFields.label: Agent Client Secret
setupFields.description: Copy the Client Secret shown once when creating your Agent Credential
